NOTICE OF A SPECIAL COUNCIL MEETING

Local Government Act 1995 - section 5.5 (2)

Notice is hereby given that a Special Council Meeting will be held on:

Date: Tuesday, 19 May 2026

Time: 5.45pm

Location: Council Chamber, 48 Old Perth Road, Bassendean

Purpose of the Meeting

The purpose of the meeting is for Council to consider the:

  • Annual Budget 2026/27 - Proposed Differential Rates

 Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Special Council Meeting

Wednesday, June 11, 2025 - 06:25 PM

NOTICE OF SPECIAL MEETING

A Special Meeting of Council was held at 6:25 pm on Wednesday 11 June 2025,
in the Council Chamber, Administration Building, 48 Old Perth Road, Bassendean.
The request to convene the meeting was received at 5.30pm on Wednesday, 11 June
2025, therefore an agenda could not be prepared.


The purpose of the meeting was for Council to reconsider their decision regarding
the EMRC from the 10 June 2025 Special Council Meeting, to provide for greater
flexibility and for the matter to remain confidential until such time as the CEO deems
appropriate.


Please note, that parts of this meeting was closed to the public, as the meeting
contained a confidential item which was be discussed by Council behind closed
doors, in accordance with s5.23 (2)(c) of the Local Government Act 1995.

Special Council Meeting

Tuesday, May 20, 2025 - 06:00 PM

Notice is hereby given that a Special Council Meeting will be held on Tuesday, 20 May 2025 commencing at 6.00pm in the Council Chamber, 48 Old Perth Road.

The purpose of the meeting is for Council to consider the Annual Budget 2025/26 - Proposed Differential Rates.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Special Council Meeting

Tuesday, May 20, 2025

  • Documents

Notice is hereby given that a Special Council Meeting will be held on Tuesday, 20 May 2025 commencing at 6.00pm in the Council Chamber, 48 Old Perth Road.

The purpose of the meeting is for Council to consider the Annual Budget 2025/26 - Proposed Differential Rates.

Members of the public are welcome to attend.

Tuesday, March 7, 2023

  • Documents

Purpose

The purpose of this report is for Council to consider the Eastern Metropolitan Regional Council (EMRC) Regional Waste Collection Service (RWCS) Participants Agreement.  

This matter will to be considered with members of the public excluded from the Chamber under Clause 5.23(c) of the Local Government Act as the officer report discusses a contract entered into, or which may be entered into, by the local government and which relates to a matter to be discussed at the meeting.

Special Council Meeting - Tuesday 29 November 2022 at 5.30pm

Tuesday, November 29, 2022 - 05:30 PM

In accordance with regulation 12 of the Local Government (Administration)
Regulations 1996, public notice is hereby given of a Special Meeting of the Council of
the Town of Bassendean, for the purpose of establishing the selection panel, including
the appointment of the independent selection panel member, for the recruitment of a
Chief Executive Officer.


The meeting will be held on Tuesday 29 November 2022, in the Council Chamber,
Administration Building 48 Old Perth Road, Bassendean, commencing at 5.30pm.

Special Council Meeting

Tuesday, June 29, 2021

  • Documents

 

In accordance with regulation 12(2) and 14D of the Local Government (Administration) Regulations 1996, public notice is hereby given that due to the public health emergency arising from the COVID-19 Pandemic, the Mayor has considered it appropriate for the Ordinary Council meeting to be held by electronic means. The meeting will commence at 6.00pm.

The purpose of the meeting is for Council to reconsider the officer recommendation for Item 16.1 Variation of Contract – Town Centre Masterplan on the agenda of the June 2021 OCM.

 This matter is to be considered confidentially under Clause 5.23 (2) (c) of the Local Government Act 1995, as the report discusses a contract which may be entered into, by the local government and which relates to a matter to be discussed at the meeting.

Special Council Meeting

Tuesday, March 24, 2020

  • Documents

Hear the recording here

Read the Response To Coronavirus here

The purpose of the meeting is to consider the:

  • Audit Completion Report for the Year Ended 30 June 2019;
  • Adoption of the Local Government 2019 Compliance Audit Return for the Town of Bassendean for the period 1 January 2019 to 31 December 2019;
  • Adoption of the Annual Budget Review for 2019/20;
  • Town’s response to the COVID-19 Pandemic; and
  • Notice of Motion relating to FOGO.

 

Please be advised that due to the rules imposed by the Australian Federal Government on social distancing, the public are strongly urged not to attend in person. An agenda for the meeting will be available on the Town’s website www.bassendean.wa.gov.au prior to the meeting.  Members of the public may still participate in public question time by providing their written questions to the Town by 5.30pm on 24 March 2020 for inclusion at the meeting.  Questions may be sent to the Town at www.yoursay.bassendean.wa.gov.au.
